notes.title: Season 7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome to Season 7 of The Crew Motorfest! This season is all about elevating your experience with exciting new features, highly requested quality-of-life improvements, two thrilling new Playlists, and much more. Here’s a full breakdown of everything included in this latest update.

[h2]Patch Sizes[/h2]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Platform[/th]
        [th]Patch Size[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]PC[/td]
        [td]44.322 GB[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Xbox Series[/td]
        [td]9.940 GB[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Xbox One[/td]
        [td]6.536 GB[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]PS5[/td]
        [td]8.407 GB[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]PS4[/td]
        [td]6.643 GB[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]New Content & Features [/h2]
[h3]Two Playlists [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Ferrari Supercars: 
[*] [New] Luxury Chronicles (Coming later / Each week a new event will drop for 12 weeks) 
[/list]

[h3]Ferrari Museum Area [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] A brand-new destination has arrived on the island! Explore the Modena Enzo Ferrari Museum space 
[/list]

[h2]Main Stage [/h2]
[h3]New Main Stage Challenge Variants [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Main Stage Challenges now offer more diverse objectives aligned with each week’s theme. 
[/list]

[h2]Racing & Grand Race Enhancements [/h2]
[h3]New Grand Race Modifiers [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Pro Racer Modifier:  
[*] Occasionally featured in Grand Races, this forces cockpit view and disables assists  
[*] [New] Alpha Jet Modifier:  
[*] Some Grand Races will now include Alpha Jet segments. 
[*] [New] New sections added 
[/list]

[h3]Grand Race Improvements [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Split Time Tracking: 
[*] See how far ahead or behind you are compared to other racers. 
[*] [New] Spectator Mode:  
[*] Watch others in real time once you finish or retire from a Grand Race. 
[*] [New] Back on Track Fixes: 
[*] Respawning has been balanced to prevent abuse. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed occurrences where the next checkpoint markers for the plane section were not displayed 
[*] [New] Matchmaking access for Grand Race and Demolition Royale can be restricted if a player's behavior does not comply with the game's Code of conduct. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed vehicle going through some obstacles during Grand Race 
[/list]
[h2]Playlist & Activity Improvements [/h2]
[h3]Playlist [/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] [Red Bull Wild Ride] Rewards value for Action list adjustment 
[*] [Fix] [Valley Isle Sailor] Challenge can now be completed with the Waterbike 
[*] [Fix] [Vintage Garage] Fixed placeholder text 
[*] [Fix] [The Joker] Reduced backflip number and wheelie distance needed 
[*] [Fix] Fixed visual bug where Prestige tickets amount would show as zero in post-race screen
[*] [Fix] [Shakotan Yoshiki] Fixed AI's path 
[*] [Fix] [Chase Squad] Chase Squad siren and police lights does not turn off after huge crashes 
[/list]

[h2]Activities [/h2]
[list]
[*] [Fix] [Custom Mode] Precision points are now properly granted for Quad vehicles in some Custom Mode events 
[*] [New] [Summit] New manual gear shifting mode 
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Updates [/h2]
[h3]Fast Fav 2.0 [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Four Custom Slots: 
[*] Assign any vehicle to any slot (no more air/land/water restrictions!) 
[*] [New] Faster Switching: 
[*] Streamlined for quicker transitions during Free Ride or events 
[/list]
[h3]Custom Show Voting Rules Update [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] We've refined how Custom Show voting works to ensure fairer outcomes and better reflect community sentiment. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed infinite loading occurring after buying the 1st place player's bundle/vehicle 
[*] [New] The festival music now remains played in the menu 
[/list]
[h3]Immersive Mode [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Immersive Mode:  
[*] New HUD toggle lets you enjoy a cleaner, more realistic experience while driving. Essential game info remains visible. 
[/list]
[h3]Recommendation System 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Recommendation System:  
[*] A new section in the vehicle shop highlights recommended vehicles for your style. 
[/list]
[h3]Summit Rewards Update [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] New thresholds: Platinum: 15K | Gold: 30K | Silver: 60K | Bronze: 60K+ 
[*] [New] Short Feats Rewards (under 20 sec): Now reward 1 Performance Part 
[*] [New] Crew invites are now supported in Summit Feats with vehicle restrictions 
[*] [Fix] Fixed an issue where friend’s leaderboard ranking was displayed in reverse order during Summit races recap 
[*] [Fix] Fixed placeholder text displayed for bucks/XP reward in several languages on summit feat reward screen 
[/list]

[h3]UI & Settings Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] SDR and HDR: 
[*] SDR and HDR settings are now simplified, with new preview functionality. 
[*] Updated image calibration options in the video menu according to the new brightness for HDR setting 
[*] [New] Vehicle Customization: 
[*] Overview camera added to Livery menu 
[*] [New] Camera Changes: 
[*] Rotation and zoom enabled in Colour menu 
[*] [New] Menu Playlist Order:  
[*] Now adapts contextually based on your progress 
[/list]

[h2]Vehicle Improvements [/h2]
[h3]Performance Tuning [/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] Alpha Jet:  
[*] Jet speed has now been adjusted for low altitude. 
[*] Updated Performance Part pool on Alpha Jet 
[*] [Fix] Tier stat tooltip: 
[*] Does not overlap with stats selection during recalibration. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed an issue where it was possible to perform a donut even when the rear wheels were locked in manual gearing 
[*] [Fix] Fixed some 4WD cars losing all traction or going backward after a sharp turn 
[*] [Fix] Fixed Steering Deadzone not being at intended default value 
[/list]

[h3]Devices [/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] Moza Flight stick now has dynamic force feedback while piloting airplanes 
[*] [Fix] Fixed some rare crashes with FFB devices 
[/list]

[h3]Handling Revisions [/h3]
The following vehicles have received handling updates to provide a more enjoyable and balanced driving experience: 

[b]Aston Martin Street T2 [/b]
[list]
[*] Aston Martin DBS
[*] Aston Martin V12 Vantage Zagato 2012 
[*] Aston Martin V8 Vantage S 2012 
[*] Aston Martin Vanquish
[/list]
 

[b]Audi Street T2 [/b]
[list]
[*] Audi RS 5 Coupe 2018 
[*] Audi RS 5 Coupe USST Official Edition 
[*] Audi RS 7 Sportback 
[*] Audi R8 Spyder 
[*] Audi R8 Spyder Motorfest Edition 
[*] Audi R8 V10 Plus Coupé 
[*] Audi RS Q8 
[*] Audi TT RS Coupe 2017 
[*] Audi TT RS Roadster 
[/list]

[b]Bentley Street T2 [/b]
[list]
[*] Bentley Continental Supersports 2010 
[*] Bentley Mulliner Bacalar 
[/list]

[b]Bugatti Street Tier 1 [/b]
[list]
[*] Bugatti Type 57 SC Atlantic 
[/list]

[b]Bugatti Hypercar [/b]
[list]
[*] Bugatti Atlantic Concept (Pebble Beach) 
[*] Bugatti Chiron & variants (Interception Unit, Carbon Edition, Super Sport 300+, Divine Edition) 
[*] Bugatti Divo & variants (Emerald Storm, Magma Edition) 
[*] Bugatti EB110 Super Sport & Anodized Edition 
[*] Bugatti La Voiture Noire 
[*] Bugatti Veyron 16.4 Grand Sport Vitesse & variants (Deep Blue, Edition One) 
[*] Bugatti Veyron Barchetta & Velvet Edition 
[/list]

[b]Citroën Hypercar [/b]
[list]
[*] Citroën GT 
[/list]

[b]Ferrari Street T2 [/b]
[list]
[*] Ferrari 512TR 
[/list]

[b]Ferrari Racing [/b]
[list]
[*] Ferrari 458 Italia GT2 
[*] Ferrari 488 GT3 & AF Corse edition 
[*] Ferrari 599XX Evo 
[*] Ferrari F40 LM 
[*] Ferrari FXX K 
[/list]

[b]Jaguar Steet T2 [/b]
[list]
[*] Jaguar F-Type SVR Coupé & Professional Edition 
[/list]

[b]Jaguar Hypercar [/b]
[list]
[*] C-X75 Concept & variants (Exo Edition, Lunar Year Edition) 
[/list]

[b]Lotus Street T2 [/b]
[list]
[*] Lotus Emira 
[*] Lotus Evora GTE 2012 & Overcut Edition 
[*] Lotus Exige S 2013 
[/list]

[b]Porsche Hypercar [/b]
[list]
[*] Porsche Carrera GT & Green Flash Edition 
[*] Porsche 911 GT1 Strabenversion (993) 
[*] Porsche 918 Spyder & Silvery Edition 
[/list]

[b]Renault Hypercar[/b]
[list]
[*] Renault Trezor Concept 
[/list]

[h3]Interior Fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] Tachometers and dashboards corrected for several vehicles. 
[*] [Fix] Shifting Animation:  
[*] Fixed on BMW M3 Sport Evolution. 
[*] [Fix] Sitting position raised on Lancer Evo X. 
[/list]

[h3]Exterior & Customization Fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] Window repairs corrected 
[*] [Fix] Windshield cracks visual effect improved 
[*] [New] Paint applications now show confirmation prompts 
[*] [Fix] Brake light brightness intensity tweaked on Aston Martin DBS 
[*] [Fix] Engine smoke VFX for Demolition Derby fixed 
[*] [Fix] Improved 3D model for Mercedes AMG One when viewed at distance with Performance Mode. 
[*] [Fix] Suspension height does not change anymore on Spyker C8 AILERON All-In Edition after changing car parts 
[*] [Fix] Improved Monster Truck Tire Contacts Stability 
[/list]

[h3]Audio Fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Off-road rolling sounds improved for all wheeled vehicles 
[*] [Fix] Red Bull Radio podcast now resumes properly 
[/list]

[h3]Music: [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] New tracks added:  
[*] Shattered – Adrian Mena Arrabal 
[*] Look – AGST 
[*] Locked In – Aiyo 
[*] Equinox – boda 
[*] Pole Position - Brian Steckler 
[*] As History Unfolds - Christoffer Moe Ditlevsen 
[*] I Will Arise - Dream Cave 
[*] Vivaldi's Summer – Elbroar 
[*] Beyond – Emoter 
[*] Release the Fire – FormantX 
[*] The Escape Plan Activated - Grant Newman 
[*] Inverted - Hampus Naeselius 
[*] Rapid Surge - Hampus Naeselius 
[*] Lock And Key - Hypersonic Music, Caleb Swift 
[*] Vivaldi: The Four Seasons, Violin Concerto in F Minor, Op. 8 No. 4, RV297, Winter: I. Allegro non molto - Jeff Meegan, Julian Gallant, David Tobin 
[*] The Ticking Heart - Jo Wandrini 
[*] Royal Ascension - Jolt trailer Music, Matthias Heider 
[*] Seismic - Judah Earl, boda 
[*] Betrayal - Matthias Heider 
[*] Vivaldi: The Four Seasons, Violin Concerto in G Minor, Op. 8 No. 2, RV315, Summer: III. Presto - Michelle Ross, Eric Jacobsen, Odyssey Orchestra 
[*] Swords on the Dance Floor - Plamen Georgiev Gospodinov 
[*] Hyper Baroque Violin - Rafael Krux 
[*] Verdi (and 74 musicians) - Thylacine 
[*] Keep Up This Time - Trevor Kowalski 
[/list]

[h3]Shop & Economy [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Prestige Ticket section updated with new content 
[*] [New] Fixed redirection not working for the AUDI R8 Spyder Motorfest Edition in the vehicle catalogue 
[*] [Fix] Fixed occurrences where the test drive spawn point did not orient the car in the road direction 
[*] [Fix] Fixed outfit parts clipping with each other 
[/list]

[h3]Vanities [/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] Fixed the "MAD FUSION NITRO" having horizontal lines briefly visible 
[*] [Fix] Some Nitro Vanities does not have infinite Endfires anymore 
[*] [Fix] Fixed issues with MAD Inferno and Orange Reactor Nitro animation which would continue even when player released the nitro button 
[*] [Fix] Player no longer encountered an error after changing vanities on the Hummer HX Concept Enforcer Unit 
[*] [Fix] Underglows can now be removed from the Creators Tempesta Rival Edition 
[/list]

[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fix] Ubisoft Connect:  
[*] Ubisoft Connect overlay does not get stuck anymore 
[*] Ubisoft Connect overlay message "[Friend] is playing The Crew Motorfest" does not get stuck anymore 
[*] [Fix] Fixed a typo on the Difficulty pop up message in German 
[*] [Fix] Added missing vehicles from the Red Bull filtering option 
[/list]

[h3]World & Events [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] New location: Resort Island & Blackrock 
[*] [New] Added new paths for Rivals Dynamic Races 
[*] [Fix] Maui terrain and collisions polished 
[*] [Fix] Overlapping/clipping textures fixed 
[*] [Fix] Improved AI paths in events and free ride 
[*] [Fix] Treasure Box exploit removed (Sniffer Set re-enabled) 
[*] [Fix] Boats no longer end below the ground after a fast travel 
[*] [Fix] Optimized water rendering 
[/list]

[h3]Customization [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Added new weather in photo mode & custom mode 
[*] [New] An overview camera was added to the Livery menus 
[*] [New] In the Colour customization menu, camera rotation & zoom can now be used 
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous [/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Impossibility to report the same vehicle with custom liveries multiple times 
[*] [Fix] Reward cinematics are now correctly adapted to Water bike 
[*] [Fix] Improved global stability and performance on all platforms 
[*] [Fix] The camera don’t doesn’t go under the water during a fast fav animation 
[*] [Fix] Fixed issues during reward movies/podium for Monster Truck vehicles 
[*] [Fix] Monster Truck vehicles camera fix 
[*] [Fix] Fixed residual visual effects on boats and planes during rewind 
[*] 
[/list]
 
Thanks for reading the Season 7 Patch Notes! We can’t wait to see what you think of all the new features, fixes, and improvements. See you on the streets and in the skies! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: The Crew Motorfest Season 6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Season 6 patch notes article for The Crew Motorfest! Here you will find a non-exhaustive list of changes and improvements coming to Motorfest with the new season.

Season 6 is here! This season brings an amazing collaboration with Red Bull, two brand-new Red Bull Playlists, exciting gameplay improvements, and major updates to certain vehicles handling, new vehicles, and PvP modes.

Want to know even more about the updates coming with Season 6? Check out our Season 6 Content Overview for a full comprehensive breakdown: https://ubi.li/HP6K4

For further updates follow our [url=https://x.com/TheCrewGame]official channels.[/url]

[h2]Patch Sizes[/h2]
[list]
[*] PC: 42GB
[*] Xbox Series X/S: 8.9GB
[*] Xbox One: 7.6GB
[*] PS5: 7.3GB
[*] PS4: 8GB
[/list]

[h2]New Content & Events[/h2]
[h3]Playlists[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition: 2 New Red Bull Playlists - Speed Clash and Wild Ride!
[*] Wild Ride will be playable May 7th.
[/list]
[h3]Playgrounds[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition: Added a new Red Bull Playground!
[*] The new playground can be found permanently in freeride near Mount Haleakalā.
[/list]
[h3]Feats[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition: New feat type - Long Jump! The longer the jump, the more points earned.
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition: Maui island has been improved with new scenery.
[*] Addition: The Prestige Tickets section in the shop has been updated with new content for this season.
[/list]
[h3]Summit[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition: New Summit gameplay modifier
[*] Pro Racing modifier will make its debut this season!
[*] New Summit gameplay modifier: "Pro Racing" will make its debut this season! This occasional modifier will require you to perform with a forced Cockpit view, no Nitro, no mini-map, and no UI tachymeter!
[/list]
[h3]Island[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition: Kihei/Wailea expansion
[*] Enhanced the areas of Kihei and Wailea adding more points of interest.
[*] Maui island improvements: Discover the trailer video here!
[*] Increased Motorfests presence with new festival locations, volcano themed art light installations and waterfalls night lighting!
[*] Added the brand-new village of Paia!
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Red Bull tracks and podcasts.
[/list]

[h2]Vehicle & Handling Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Handling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gear shifting time is now more consistent across both manual & automatic modes.
[*] Added an option for Radial Deadzones in controller settings.
[*] Updated Quad physics to avoid unwanted behaviors.
[*] Back-On-Track won't trigger as often after big jumps on motorbikes.
[/list]
[h3]Bike Handling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bike handling on slopes has been improved, especially on banked terrain.
[*] Check out the dedicated handling improvements article here! https://ubi.li/c6HAL
[/list]
[h3]Interior Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ferrari F40 LM Racing: Interior dashboard now displays correctly.
[*] Road reflections are now properly displayed in interior view.
[*] Interior colors can now be reverted to default after changes.
[*] Fixed interior objects clipping
[/list]
[h3]Collection[/h3]
[list]
[*] Suzuki GSX-R1000R now correctly imports from The Crew 2 via Collection Import.
[/list]
[h3]AI Vehicles[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chase Squad vehicles will no longer appear without liveries.
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] KTM RC16: Engine sound has been improved
[*] Planes: Wheels surfaces rolling sounds improved
[*] Planes: Stall Warning feedback improved
[*] Planes: Added landing Gear movement sounds
[*] Boats: Water sounds improved
[*] Helicopter: Added specific vibration with Dualsense wireless controller
[*] Anti-lag audio signature now sounds correct in Free Drive.
[/list]
[h3]Planes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Planes will now make a splash sound when hitting water.
[*] Planes wheel friction now has improved consistency.
[*] Planes and helicopters cameras have been improved
[*] Fast back view, improved stability, smoother controls, improved collisions in tunnels.
[/list]
[h3]Customization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chevrolet Impala LowRider Naranja Ed.: Caliper color now correctly reflects changes in customization menu.
[*] Hummer H1 Alpha US Wildlife Watchers Rooftops now display correctly.
[/list]
[h3]Interior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lamborghini Urus: Digital speedometer no longer flickers during interior color customization.
[*] McLaren 12C GT3: Caliper color now reflects changes in the Vehicule customization menu.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay & Competition Updates[/h2]
[h3]Event Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] "3,2,1 Go!" event starting animations updated to match each playlist theme.
[*] New visual indicators show when reward boosts are active (menus, reward flow).
[/list]
[h3]Back on track[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed occurrences where colliding with water with certain vehicles would cause a respawn loop.
[/list]
[h3]Main Stage[/h3]
[list]
[*] Summit: Feats in Summit context have been improved
[*] Traffic can now be removed from all Feats in Summit when deemed necessary.
[*] Summit vehicle constraint can now be applied to Summit Feats. You need to own the constraint vehicle to participate in Summit Feats where this applies.
[*] Unlike Summit Events, vehicle loan from your Crew leader is not active for Summit Feats.
[*] Custom Show:
[*] Updated the spawning behavior of the Custom Show vehicles in the Car Meet, to prevent the voting system from being abused.
[*] "Custom Show Vehicle Registration" Main Stage Challenge now validates consistently.
[*] Fixed low-resolution interior display when registering and customizing a car in Custom Show menu.
[/list]
[h3]Rivals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rivals Chase & Race activities now reward increased Bucks & XP.
[/list]

[h2]PvP Enhancements[/h2]
[h3]Grand Race[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fast Fav camera transitions are now smoother
[*] Trajectory is now more consistent after a vehicle switch.
[*] Collisions are inactive up to a certain speed in default Grand Race modes.
[*] New gameplay modifiers (Main Stage Vehicles & Weathers) will periodically activate in Grand Race.
[*] Demolition Royale matches can now start with 12 players.
[*] Demolition Royale Ultimate ability can no longer have its tires burst.
[*] Added new weather for Maui arena in Demolition Royale.
[*] The end-of-race flow has been revised, allowing all players to finish and immediately receive rewards.
[*] Grand Race events will now periodically feature different weather conditions.
[*] Fixed incorrect asset placements & misaligned navigation lines.
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]World & Free Ride Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Maui Island[/h3]
[list]
[*] New art & light installations added across Maui.
[*] Kihei area has been reworked.
[*] A brand-new Red Bull playground is available near the Maui volcano!
[/list]
[h3]Free Ride[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed floating assets, inconsistent/invisible collisions, clipping textures, and flickering assets across the map.
[*] Fixed AI traffic behavior in Free Drive to prevent sudden turns & spawning in front of players.
[/list]

[h2]Interface & Quality of Life Updates[/h2]
[h3]Moderation[/h3]
[list]
[*] A log message now appears when an equipped livery is deleted due to moderation.
[*] More player reporting options are available when selecting another player's profile.
[/list]
[h3]Mini Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collectibles can now be hidden from the mini map once collected.
[/list]
[h3]News[/h3]
[list]
[*] News description text no longer overlaps with the border.
[/list]
[h3]Friends[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed occurrences where friends would disappear from the friends list.
[/list]
[h3]Weather[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ocean'N Sky: Visibility is no longer hindered by clouds during Red Winds event.
[/list]
[h3]Collectibles Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] New camera animation when collecting collectibles.
[/list]
[h3]Artificial Horizon Indicator[/h3]
[list]
[*] Indicator will now work more consistently.
[/list]
[h3]Slipstream[/h3]
[list]
[*] In freestyle, slipstream will now trigger more accurately.
[/list]
[h3]Hori Gear Shifter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has default mapping.
[/list]
[h3]Challenges Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has redirections and auto-switching.
[/list]
[h3]Photo Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now possible to teleport to completed Photo quests location after unlocking the Fast Travel
[/list]

[h2]Additional Fixes & Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Chase squad[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues from The Chase Squad playlist: missing subtitles, misspelled words, voice over issues, wrong requirements, and world best score screen infinite loading
[/list]
[h3]Playlist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed occurrences where the racing line was misaligned
[*] There are now 7 visible Vcat in the custom mode menu for Waimea Sky event in  Off-roading Addict playlist, instead of 5
[/list]
[h3]Maui Volcano[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved lighting around the volcano.
[*] Improved rendering from the volcano's plume of smoke.
[/list]
[h3]Animation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistent fingers animation on avatar
[*] Fixed Windshield Wiper animation on Pagani Utopia car
[*] "Shake it" animation no longer restarts on events' victory screen
[/list]
[h3]Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "yellow dot" behavior indicating new available content is now more consistent
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Combo lost" text is not impacting anymore while using rewind feature
[*] "Tier performance adjustment" tip does not overlap anymore with stats selection interface during recalibration
[*] Added commas for scoring leaderboard and currencies in profile menu for polish text language
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Objective Reached" audio feedback during skills improved
[*] Number of audible opponent's vehicles and collisions increased on PS4 and Xbox1
[*] 7.1 increase the resolution on rear/side speakers on PS4 and XB1
[*] 3D Audio optimizations and spatial resolution increased on PS5
[*] Streamer friendly music is no longer stopped when switching the parameter
[*] Music playing radio during first playlist selection was fixed
[*] Fixed boot world SFX audible in onboarding menu
[*] Music tracklist continuity from freeride to PVP
[*] Fixed an audio desynchronization issue between engines layers
[*] "Redliner Kit" engine sound improved
[*] Music is not muffled anymore after a Pit stop in Motorsport playlist events
[/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Nihon No Top Driver" and "Nihon No Club" challenges can now be completed
[*] MITSUBISHI LANCER EVOLUTION X is now required for the "Nihon No Weapon X" challenge
[*] Challenges notification interface now offers more options and allows to switch to the right vehicle
[*] Progression for Alpha Endurance challenge now works correctly
[/list]
[h3]Shop[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Ok" button does no longer disappears after a quick change between color selection and preview option
[/list]
[h3]Vanities[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hula Rooftop is no longer merged with the roof of the Porsche 911 GT3 RS
[/list]
[h3]Animation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Manual shifting animation no longer plays instead of the automatic one on Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat 2017
[/list]
[h3]Customization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Underglow vanities now properly apply on the Ferrari F40
[*] Livery no longer fades out on fender edges when selecting front bumper n°8 on Volkswagen GOLF GTI
[/list]
[h3]Interior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animation added for Turbo-meter on Nissan Z dashboard
[*] Camera position is no longer misaligned while customizing dashboard figures
[*] The dashboard tachometer now matches the interface tachometer
[/list]
[h3]Exterior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed occurrences where cars' logos were blurred, inverted, and/or missing
[/list]

notes.title: The Crew Motorfest Season 5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Year 2 of The Crew Motorfest is coming in hot with Season 5, and with it comes a variety of new patch notes! Our latest patch introduces the long-awaited FREE map expansion of Maui, as well as the brand-new Year 2 Pass, which includes the new Chase Squad Playlist, along with 7 Chase vehicles and 13 additional vehicles, which will be released through monthly drops! The new editions will be available at 9AM UTC and 6PM UTC on Steam

We've put together this non-exhaustive list of the changes to come in these patch notes. You can also check out our [url=https://ubi.li/wmwdC]Season 5 Quality of Life Article[/url] to learn more about our decisions.
For a more detailed breakdown of the content released in Season 5 please refer to the Content Overview.

Please follow our [url=https://x.com/TheCrewGame]official channels[/url] for any additional updates.

[h2]DETAILED PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[h3]Patch Size per platform[/h3]

[list]
[*] PC: 40.928 GB
[*] PlayStation 4: 14.386GB

[/list]

notes.title: The Crew Motorfest Season 4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Season 4 of The Crew Motorfest just released and with it comes a variety of new patch notes! Our latest patch introduces some quality-of-life updates to the game - like more customization options, improvements to Summit and the Custom Show!

We've put together this non-exhaustive list of the changes to come in these patch notes. You can also check out our [url=https://ubi.li/YU3jy]Season 4 Quality of Life Article[/url] to learn more about our decisions.

For a more detailed breakdown of the content released in Season 4 please refer to the Content Overview.

Please follow our [url=https://twitter.com/TheCrewGame]official channels[/url] for any additional updates.

[h2]DETAILED PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h3]PATCH SIZE PER PLATFORM[/h3]
[list]
[*] PC: 35.41 GB     
[*] PlayStation 4: 6.658 GB
[*] PlayStation 5: 6.466 GB
[*] Xbox One: 8.126 GB
[*] Xbox Series: 10.315 GB
[/list]
Patch sizes may vary based on your game version.

[h3]EVENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Playlist: Donk vs Lowrider: Get ready for an epic dive into two iconic car styles!
[*] [New] Playlist: Off Roading Addict Vol.2: available on August 14th
[*] [New] Difficulty Setting Reminder: We've added a reminder to the Playlist content menu and Summit menu.
[*] [Fix] Joy & Excitement: AI does not get stuck anymore!
[*] [Fix] Hanauma Waters Event: AI drivers are now better behaved.
[*] [Fix] Motorsport Prologue: Fixed instances where some AI cars would go off track after using the rewind feature at the start of the Motorsport Prologue.
[*] [Fix] Navigation event exploitation: We've fixed the issue where navigation events could be exploited by creating them in checkpoints. Since this is a completely new behavior, we'll reset the leaderboard for such an event during the July 3 maintenance.
[*] [Fix] Raptor X Delicacy Event: Corrected the time format for best lap times in this event.
[*] [Fix] Scene 7: The Love Story: The rewards are back to their original values.
[*] [Fix] Tallahassee Melee Event: Rally Cars can now be selected in Custom Mode.
[/list]
[h3]CONTROLS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Dynamic Suspension: Experience this new feature for Low Riders during Free Roam by activating it with the following controls:
[*] Xbox: Press B to engage the Dynamic Suspension System.
[*] PlayStation: Press circle to activate the Dynamic Suspension System.
[*] Press the same button again to toggle between three modes:
[*] Regular: Standard suspension behavior.
[*] All Directions: Allows dynamic movement in all directions.
[*] Lock: Locks the suspension in place.
[*] [Fix] Mouse controls now work when using the filter options in the shop.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a crash with the latest version of the Logitech GHUB.
[*] [Fix] It is now possible to set new key bindings from the Wheel and Accessories menu.
[*] [Fix][PS4] Hori Racing Wheel Apex now works as intended.
[/list]
[h3]MENUES[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Changed] Completed Side Activity Status: The status for completed side activities now appears in green on the progress meter of any playlist
[*] [Changed] Vehicle Collection Thumbnails: We've optimized loading times for vehicle thumbnails in the Vehicle Collection. Now you can browse your cars more efficiently.
[*] [Changed] Horizontal Vehicle Sorting: Vehicles are now sorted horizontally based on their level.
[*] [Fix] The main stage title reward text no longer overlaps the image in large text settings.
[*] [Fix] Crew members' weather icons in cinematics will now display correctly after adjusting the weather settings in any event. Stay informed!
[*] [Fix] Fixed the missing yellow dot icon that indicates a new upgrade is available for a vehicle. Keep your rides up to date!
[*] [Fix] Added an "Engine Type" sorting option for filtering vehicles. Customize your collection your way.
[*] [Fix] Summit points text no longer overflows.
[/list]
[h3]VEHICLES[/h3]
[list]
[*] [New] Dashboard Figures & Glass Hangers: Earn these new vanities as rewards throughout the game. Customize your dashboard and add some flair to your ride!
[*] [New] Adjustable Rim Size: You can now update rim size on several vehicles that had this option available in The Crew 2.
[*] [Changed] Livery Material Modification: You can now edit the "modify material" tab for liveries using the D-pad.
[*] [Fix] We've fine-tuned the movement of several rooftop vanities.
[*] [Fix] When zooming in on classic vehicles in the customization menu, liveries will no longer get distorted. Enjoy a clear view of your artwork.
